description.value:
You call the boss summon of your contract clan — Gamabunta of the Toads, Manda of the Snakes, Katsuyu of the Slugs. The boss arrives in an unoccupied area of at least 3-by-3 squares within 60 feet and acts under your direction for 1 minute.

The boss is a Huge minion with stats appropriate to a level-(spell rank + 6) creature; full stat blocks are deferred to Milestone 6 bestiary. As a baseline: AC 24, 250 HP, 3 actions per turn, a Huge melee Strike at +18 dealing 4d10+10 bludgeoning, and a signature once-per-summon ability (Toad → oil-and-fire combo with allied fire-caster; Snake → massive constrict; Slug → mass split + party-wide fast healing 5).

You take 1d6 chakra strain (treat as nonlethal damage equal to your level) from sustaining the boss; you cannot summon another boss for 24 hours.

system.requirements: you have signed a contract; you have not used Boss Summon in the last 24 hours
